title: Dave Altman connects the transient dates to the Washington flap

tellings.quote: And then my colleague, Dave Altman, who is the manager media manager for WASCO, he said, "Do you know what happens on or what happened on 19th of July, 1952?"

plain: An astronomer named Beatriz Villarroel, who studies brief points of light that show up and vanish on old photographs of the sky, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a moment with a colleague. Dave Altman, the media manager for her research project, asked her if she knew what happened on 19 July 1952, the date of a wave of UFO sightings over Washington, D.C. She tells it because it links the dates of her strange flashes to that famous wave of sightings, which would suggest the two are connected.
